name: merchant-presets
description: Build tooling for the Merchant Presets Foundry VTT module

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:actions
scripts.pack: npm run pack:merchants && npm run pack:stock && npm run pack:goods
scripts.pack:merchants: fvtt package pack -n merchants --id merchant-presets --type Module --in _source/merchants --out packs
scripts.pack:stock: fvtt package pack -n stock --id merchant-presets --type Module --in _source/stock --out packs
scripts.pack:goods: fvtt package pack -n goods --id merchant-presets --type Module --in _source/goods --out packs
